verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants for exposing different versions of a feature as part of A/B and multivariate testing, so running the experiments is supported. The other half of the story, seeing which variation wins on metrics, is not evidenced: impact metrics cover rollout safeguards (error rates, latency), not per-variant experiment analysis. missing for 10: per-variant metric comparison or winner/statistical-significance reporting, experiment results dashboard, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.
